column1: # Expected column widths from Prettier's own getStringWidth, not from this repository.
# Generated by running prettier 3.9.6's src/utilities/get-string-width.js verbatim
# emoji-regex 10.6.0, get-east-asian-width 1.6.0 and narrow-emojis 0.0.3 under Node.
# Because the file is an oracle dump, a line may only be changed by regenerating it
# against a Prettier release - never by writing down what this package currently returns.
# Coverage: the worked examples from the #185 width spec, every narrow-emojis code point
# bare and again with U+FE0F, and one representative sequence per emoji-test.txt subgroup
# per qualification status (Unicode emoji 17.0, 2025-08-04). The same generator run over
# every emoji-test.txt sequence, each also embedded in ASCII, doubled, and placed beside
# wide and combining neighbours, produced 20900 cases that all agree with displayWidth;
# that full sweep is development evidence and is deliberately not committed at 860 KiB.
# Code points are hex, space separated; an empty field is the empty string.
